chain_words.nuance: mild belief that something good may happen
general expectation that things will turn out well
strong belief in your own ability
complete conviction with no doubt at all

explanation: These words all describe a positive belief about outcomes or abilities, rising from a hopeful wish to complete certainty with no doubt.

usage_notes.difference: 'Confident' describes trust in your own ability, while 'assured' often describes a calm, certain manner that others notice when you speak or act.
